result.summary: Several visual issues are present: a broken/missing restaurant image placeholder, truncated restaurant name text, and incomplete content loading in the Popular section.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a large empty gray area with only a generic image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback image so the card is not visually broken.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and cut off at the edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The Popular right now section has a large blank gray block with a broken image icon, making the layout look incomplete and broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load correctly; show a skeleton loader or hide the card until content is available.

issues.description: Category filter chips on the right (after Healthy) are partially cut off, indicating horizontal overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/scroll indicators or ensure the last visible chip isn't clipped awkwardly.
